Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Sri Lanka players are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Evin Lewis will open the innings for West Indies. Suranga Lakmal will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka.
Right then! West Indies need 275 runs to win. Will they chase it and whitewash Sri Lanka 3-0 or will Sri Lankan bowlers defend the total? Join us for the chase in 30 minutes.

Coming to West Indies, their bowlers were poor in the death. Akeal Hosein looked good as he took 3 wickets and was economical. Jason Mohammed took a solitary wicket but did well to restrict the scoring. Holder and Phillip were on the expensive side.

Sri Lanka got off to a great start as their openers started well. They lost their way in between where they lost wickets at regular intervals. Chandimal started well but could not last longer. Shanaka also played a poor shot. Bandara and Hasaranga's partnership was the saving grace for Sri Lanka.

It has been an incredible finish for Sri Lanka. Wanindu Hasaranga and Ashen Bandara's partnership has helped them cross 270. They were attacking the West Indies bowlers and smashed them on all parts of the ground. Hasaranga was suffering from cramps but still he fought that and stayed till the end. He made an unbeaten 80.

We are all set to begin. The West Indies players are out in the middle. Danushka Gunathilaka and Dimuth Karunaratne will open the innings for Sri Lanka. Jason Holder will start the proceedings for West Indies.

Dimuth Karunaratne, Sri Lanka skipper, says that we knew the series was gone but they would look to get the 2 points for the ODI Super League. Adds that they will look to take wickets in the middle overs. Informs they have three changes.

Kieron Pollard, West Indies skipper, says that they will field first. Adds that the conditions are good for chasing and the track is a little brownish. Mentions that they will look to restrict Sri Lanka to a low total. Informs they have one change. Further says as a bowling unit they will look to finish off the innings well.
West Indies (Playing XI) - Evin Lewis, Shai Hope (WK), Nicholas Pooran, Darren Bravo, Kieron Pollard (C), Fabian Allen, Jason Holder, Jason Mohammed, Akeal Hosein, Alzarri Joseph, Anderson Phillip.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Pathum Nissanka, Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Ashen Bandara, Lakshan Sandakan, Thisara Perera, Wanindu Hasaranga, Dasun Shanaka, Suranga Lakmal, Asitha Fernando.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. West Indies win the toss and elect to field!

Hello and welcome to the 3rd ODI between West Indies and Sri Lanka in Antigua. The hosts would look to whitewash Sri Lanka 3-0. They would want their middle-order to be tested. On the other hand, Sri Lanka would look to win this match for pride. They would want their bowling to come good. Stay tuned for the toss and the team updates.
